Due to a temporary closure, there is no accessible corridor directly connecting Gallery Alpha and Gallery Beta. Furthermore, due to a special exhibition routing constraint, the tour must incorporate exactly one of the following two corridors: the one between Gallery Beta and Gallery Gamma, or the one between Gallery Gamma and Gallery Delta.

The objective is to determine the shortest possible circuit that visits every gallery precisely once and concludes at the initial gallery.
